tasks.short: Research environmental problems and economic production and consumption patterns.

steps.what: Choose research questions, causal framework and actual environmental and economic source definitions
inputs: actual environmental research question
actual source availability and methodological constraints
outputs: chosen research design and source contract

steps.what: Transfer existing production, consumption and environmental source tables into the research workspace
inputs: chosen research design and source contract
actual existing source-owner exports
outputs: staged source tables with provenance and unmatched fields

steps.what: Validate actual source coverage, units, prices, geography and missing-data treatment
inputs: staged source tables with provenance and unmatched fields
chosen research design and source contract
outputs: validated research dataset and explicit limitations

steps.what: Conduct research on actual environmental problems and production and consumption relationships
inputs: validated research dataset and explicit limitations
chosen research design and source contract
outputs: actual relationship analyses, interpretations and research limits

steps.what: Write and check actual research findings and retain the internal research record
inputs: actual relationship analyses, interpretations and research limits
outputs: checked saved actual research findings

tasks.design: Test native source connectors in {DATA_PLATFORM} before a deterministic bridge from existing {SPREADSHEET} exports. Remove actual repeated table transfer while retaining design, source-definition reconciliation, scientific analysis and complete written findings; no new observation or causal finding is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing source tables may be moved by hand between stores.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned mappings can stage real tables with source provenance.
tasks.still_hard: Coverage, prices and confounding affect the interpretation of relationships.
tasks.human_edge: The economist rejects a relationship explained by a source-definition change.
tasks.altitude: Less source movement; research judgement remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic source-table transfer can remove repeated handling without deciding environmental-economic relationships.

assumptions: Provisional scenario requires actual manual cross-store table transfer20 today; existing native imports/runtime earn zero new saving. Confirm actual effort before using these shares. No new primary data collection is omitted: this boundary uses existing source-owner tables.

Actual statistical/environmental data owners supply source id/version, geography, sector/product, period, quantity/unit, currency/price base and environmental measure/method. Economist chooses definitions in s1, validates mismatches/missing fields in s3 and clarifies absent inputs manually. Written scientific findings and their ordinary internal save remain unchanged and ungated.
unknowns: Which source transfers are actually manual?
Are source definitions sufficiently stable for mappings?
research_questions: Can a staged join reconcile totals and preserve sector/geography changes without new manual cleanup?

incremental.description: Maintain source versions, mappings and reconciliation failures.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 actual table-transfer points minus1.2 upkeep=18.8. Low: a revised consumption classification leaves10 transfer points needing manual reshaping; only10 unchanged production/environment transfer points disappear, minus1.2=8.8. Design, validation, research interpretation and written findings keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform integrated dynamic environmental and economic mathematical modelling.

steps.what: Specify actual ecological, environmental and economic model equations, boundaries and coupling assumptions
inputs: actual modelling question and available evidence
outputs: chosen integrated dynamic model specification

steps.what: Calibrate and validate actual parameters, units, initial states and scenario grid
inputs: chosen integrated dynamic model specification
actual observed calibration data and chosen scenarios
outputs: verified model version and explicit parameter/scenario grid

steps.what: Prepare repeated scenario input files and launch model runs from the verified grid
inputs: verified model version and explicit parameter/scenario grid
outputs: actual scenario-run outputs with model/parameter provenance

steps.what: Check convergence, conservation, sensitivity and actual implications of integrated model outputs
inputs: actual scenario-run outputs with model/parameter provenance
chosen integrated dynamic model specification
outputs: checked actual model results, failures and interpretation

steps.what: Write and check actual model findings and retain the internal modelling record
inputs: checked actual model results, failures and interpretation
outputs: checked saved actual modelling record

tasks.design: Configure native batch/scenario input generation in modelling {DATA_PLATFORM} from the economist's explicit verified grid. Remove repeated human run preparation, retaining model construction, calibration, complete scientific output checks and the actual modelling record; existing numerical runtime earns zero saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scenario files may be prepared and runs launched repeatedly by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameter-grid batching can generate exact input variants and provenance.
tasks.still_hard: Coupled equations, calibration and model validity remain scientific work.
tasks.human_edge: The economist detects stable numerical output from an invalid structural assumption.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated run setup; modelling decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native scenario batching can remove repeated input preparation while integrated model validity remains expert work.

assumptions: Provisional scenario requires actual repeated human input-file/launch effort20, not solver runtime. Already automated batch runs receive zero new saving. If native batching is unavailable, re-estimate a tested deterministic bridge instead of assuming configuration works.

Economist produces actual model/version, variable names, values/units, initial conditions, time step/horizon and scenario ids in s1/s2. Missing or incompatible values remain manual modelling work. Automatic runs cannot choose scenarios, accept convergence or change policy. Internal record writing/save stays unchanged without self-approval.
unknowns: Does the actual solver already support configured scenario batches?
research_questions: Can batching reproduce known runs and preserve unit, seed and model-version provenance?

incremental.description: Maintain scenario input schemas, model-version compatibility and failed-run handling.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes20 repeated human run-preparation points minus1.5 upkeep=18.5. Low: most scenarios change model structure and need individual manual setup; only5 unchanged parameter-variant preparation points disappear, minus1.5=3.5. Equations, calibration, scientific checks and written findings keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify actual policy options, social/legal context and economic impact evidence
inputs: actual policy, standard or program options
actual completed analysis and current contextual sources
outputs: chosen impact findings, limitations and verified source packet

steps.what: Assemble impact statement sections, sourced tables and references
inputs: chosen impact findings, limitations and verified source packet
actual required statement sections
outputs: complete sourced impact statement structure

steps.what: Write social, legal or economic impact statement prose from chosen findings
inputs: complete sourced impact statement structure
chosen impact findings, limitations and verified source packet
outputs: complete source-linked impact statement draft

loop.purpose: Draft faithful impact explanations from chosen verified findings
loop.input: actual options, sourced findings/tables, limitations and required sections
loop.output: draft with source links for every impact claim
loop.check: Economist checks distributional effects, causal language, uncertainty, legal-source meaning and omitted adverse effects against actual evidence
loop.stop: Missing current source, unsupported claim or two failed revisions returns section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed sections and tables serve s2; varied impact explanations need semantic drafting and checking

steps.what: Complete and check the whole impact statement and retain its final internal version
inputs: complete source-linked impact statement draft
chosen impact findings, limitations and verified source packet
outputs: checked saved final impact statement and decision-maker destination

steps.what: Review final impact statement and authorise its specified decision-maker release
inputs: checked saved final impact statement and decision-maker destination
outputs: independently authorised final statement version and destination

steps.what: Send the exact authorised impact statement to the specified external decision maker
inputs: independently authorised final statement version and destination
outputs: actual statement delivery record

tasks.design: Configure statement structure/table reuse in {DOCS}, then draft varied impact explanations only from the economist's verified findings. Retain complete final author checks, the actual independent assessment review and explicit external {EMAIL} release; ordinary internal saving and actual delivery earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Impact tables and explanations are repeatedly prepared from analysis outputs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structure plus source-constrained drafting can reduce assembly and first-draft typing.
tasks.still_hard: Distributional consequences, uncertainty and legal meaning require accountable assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The economist keeps an adverse effect visible even when the aggregate result looks favourable.
tasks.altitude: Less statement preparation; assessment and release authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked drafting can assist impact explanations while legal meaning and economic interpretation require full expert checks.

assumptions: Provisional external-report route with an existing independent impact assessment reviewer5, excluded from focal baseline95; no new approval job. An internal-only statement uses its real internal release route instead. Actual analysis production is upstream; s1 still verifies sources and selects findings.

Analysis/source owners supply actual option/scenario id, date/version, population, cost/benefit units and uncertainty, plus current legal/context sources. Missing evidence is clarified manually, not invented. Six of15 assembly points are repeated section/table handling; nine of30 prose points are first-draft typing removed after retained semantic checks. Existing automation earns zero new credit.
unknowns: Which actual independent review and destination apply?
Are source rights and current context available for drafting?
research_questions: Can every impact claim trace to actual analysis without losing uncertainty or adverse distributional effects?

incremental.description: Maintain impact-statement sections, source bindings and meaning checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact saved final impact statement and external decision-maker destination reviewed in s5; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes6 assembly plus9 prose points:15/95*100 minus1.5=14.289. Low: a policy with changing legal context needs fresh explanations and tables; only2 stable structure points and2 descriptive prose points disappear, giving4/95*100 minus1.5=2.710. Evidence selection, whole-statement checks, independent review and send retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Choose environmental economics learning objectives, methods and course-specific examples
inputs: actual curriculum and learner needs
actual selected environmental economics sources
outputs: chosen lesson objectives and examples

steps.what: Prepare selected environmental economics diagrams, examples and exercise sections
inputs: chosen lesson objectives and examples
actual current selected diagrams and exercise sections
outputs: complete lesson-material draft

steps.what: Check complete lesson material, economic assumptions, units and exercise answers and save it internally
inputs: complete lesson-material draft
actual selected environmental economics sources
outputs: checked saved final environmental economics lesson material

steps.what: Teach actual environmental economics courses and respond to learners' questions
inputs: checked saved final environmental economics lesson material
actual learners and questions
outputs: actual teaching, learner responses and questions

steps.what: Write and check assigned actual teaching observations and follow-up notes
inputs: actual teaching, learner responses and questions
outputs: checked saved actual teaching follow-up notes

tasks.design: Configure selected diagram and exercise-section reuse in {DOCS}/{LMS}. Keep example selection, economic explanation, complete answer/assumption checks, actual teaching and assigned fresh follow-up notes; ordinary internal saves have no self-gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable diagrams and exercise sections can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section reuse can remove assembly without choosing pedagogy.
tasks.still_hard: Learners need explanation of assumptions, tradeoffs and uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: The economist spots when learners confuse monetary value with the full environmental consequence.
tasks.altitude: Less material assembly; teaching and learning decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reusable diagrams and exercises can reduce preparation while environmental economics teaching remains human.

assumptions: Provisional preparation25 includes five repeat diagram/section assembly points; twenty actual adaptation points remain, plus full checks10. Existing reuse earns no credit. Source owners supply actual section revision, economic assumptions, price/quantity units and exercise answers; missing material is prepared manually.

Instructor captures actual learner questions after teaching. Follow-up notes only if actually assigned; remove/reweight otherwise. No inferred attendance or competence, invented grade transfer or extra material send. Actual separately owned assessment/publication steps require their own mapping.
unknowns: Which lesson components are already reused?
research_questions: Can reused exercises preserve current environmental assumptions and units?

incremental.description: Maintain current economic diagrams, exercise assumptions and answer checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 stable material-assembly points minus0.5 upkeep=4.5. Low: a specialist new environmental topic needs fresh examples and exercises, leaving only1 stable method-diagram point reusable, minus0.5=0.5. Selection, complete checking, teaching and actual follow-up retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce actual repeated data/run handling and selected writing preparation while retaining scientific and teaching decisions.
role.ambitious_version: Reliable repeatable preparation supports economists who retain model, policy and teaching judgement.
